description: Create a text snapshot of your current JStock portfolio. JStock is open on the 'My Portfolio' tab containing AAPL (123 units) and MSFT (45 units). Your task is to select all rows in the portfolio table, copy them to the clipboard, and paste the content into a new text file named 'portfolio_snapshot.txt' in the '/home/ga/Documents/' directory. You can use any text editor (like Text Editor/gedit) to save the file. The file should contain the plain text representation of the table.
